## ✨ Added

- **Euro Office under OpenCloud's own address.** With **Web office suite** set to `euro-office`, OpenCloud passes the editor through at `/euro-office/`, so **Office document server URL** is the address the Euro Office WebUI button opens, e.g. `http://192.168.1.10:9900`. There is no second certificate to accept, and from outside (reverse proxy, Tailscale) only OpenCloud has to be reachable. Update the [Euro Office](https://github.com/junkerderprovinz/euro-office) container too, since it strips the prefix again; an `https://` address keeps working as well.
- **Files can live apart from Data.** The template has a new **Files** path. Point it at a single array disk, for example `/mnt/disk1/opencloud/files`, and OpenCloud keeps your files there while Data, with the message bus, search index and accounts, stays on the SSD or cache pool. That helps when the pool is too small for all your files, because Data on the array is what stalls large syncs (#31). The container hands the folder to `PUID`:`PGID` at startup, and no other setting is needed. Set it before the first start. On an install that already has files, the log names the folder they were left in.

## 🐛 Fixed

- **A damaged search index no longer stops the server.** When OpenCloud's bleve search index could not be opened, for example because one of its segment files was missing, the `search` service failed five times and took the whole server down with it (#31). The container now checks every index before OpenCloud starts and moves one that cannot be opened to `<name>.broken`, so OpenCloud starts with a new, empty index. It then indexes all spaces again in the background, and repeats an interrupted run on the next start.

## ⚡ Improved

- **Search is rebuilt after an index schema change.** When an image update switches OpenCloud to a new index format, for example OpenCloud 8 moving from `search/bleve` to `search/bleve-v5`, the new index is filled automatically instead of staying empty until someone runs `opencloud search index` by hand.
- **A warning when a Personal space goes missing.** If the folder of a personal space loses the attributes OpenCloud keeps on it, for example because another folder was copied over it, OpenCloud drops the space from the web UI without an error and does not rebuild it (#31). The container now checks these folders at startup and names any broken one in the log.
- **A warning for an http office URL with Collabora or OnlyOffice.** Browsers block an http editor inside the https OpenCloud page, and documents then open blank without any error. The log now says so at startup.
- While Euro Office is selected, OpenCloud's Content-Security-Policy allows `'unsafe-eval'` scripts, `blob:` workers and `data:` fonts, which the editor needs.
- The managed `proxy.yaml` holds the routes for Euro Office and the branding app together. A `proxy.yaml` of your own stays untouched; Euro Office is then reached directly, and the log says so.
- The web office fields sit in the template's normal view, and their descriptions say what to enter.
- Guide (`docs/guide.md`): the web office section walks through the Euro Office setup in three steps.
- Guide (`docs/guide.md`): a troubleshooting entry shows how to copy existing files straight into the Data folder without breaking anything, and how to get **Personal** back once it is gone.
- Guide (`docs/guide.md`): a troubleshooting entry for a log that ends with `unable to publish event` and `fatal error - exiting`. It means the internal message bus stopped answering, and the entry shows how to check whether the Data folder sits in RAM or on a disk that hangs. The large-folder sync entry no longer puts it all on slow storage, because a current OpenCloud on the Unraid array did not reproduce it.
- Guide (`docs/guide.md`): a section on keeping files in a separate folder, with the steps to move existing files over. The large-folder sync entry points to it.
- Guide (`docs/guide.md`): the troubleshooting entry for a damaged search index explains the new log lines and what to attach to a report, since the cause of the damage is still open.
- Updated build dependencies: bbolt for the search index check, and newer vite, vitest and pnpm for the branding app.

## 🎨 Design

- A shorter README with download buttons for Unraid, Docker and the source, and pictures of the file view and of a document open in Euro Office.
